recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下成片細胞的卵圓核帶有明顯的縱向核溝與折疊（咖啡豆狀），胞質淡嗜酸性且邊界不清，散在嗜酸性球，是蘭格漢斯細胞組織球增生症（LCH）的典型細胞學。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium-sized cells with moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders
Oval to reniform nuclei with conspicuous longitudinal grooves, folds and notches (coffee-bean nuclei)
Fine, evenly dispersed chromatin with thin nuclear membranes and small or inconspicuous nucleoli
Scattered eosinophils with bright red granules and occasional small lymphocytes
Mild nuclear atypia without marked pleomorphism
describe_en: High-power section shows diffuse sheets of medium-sized cells with moderate amounts of pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and indistinct borders. The nuclei are oval to reniform with prominent longitudinal grooves and folds, fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Scattered eosinophils and occasional small lymphocytes are admixed. Marked pleomorphism and atypical mitoses are not seen. Findings are consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis; confirmation with CD1a and langerin (CD207) immunohistochemistry is recommended.

ddx.vs: Langerhans cell sarcoma has overtly malignant nuclei with prominent nucleoli, marked pleomorphism and high mitotic rate.
Rosai-Dorfman cells have round nuclei with a single nucleolus, very abundant pale cytoplasm with emperipolesis, and are CD1a-negative.
PTCL shows atypical lymphoid cells lacking grooved histiocytoid nuclei and is CD3-positive, CD1a-negative.
Mast cells have round to spindled nuclei without grooves and are tryptase/CD117 positive.
